scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c blue,green "pnpm run dev:api" "pnpm run dev:web"
scripts.dev:api: uv run --project apps/api uvicorn hypersignal_api.main:app --reload --reload-dir apps/api/src --port 8000
scripts.lint: pnpm run lint:web && pnpm run lint:api
scripts.lint:api: uv run --directory apps/api ruff check . && uv run --directory apps/api ruff format --check .
scripts.fmt: pnpm --filter web format && uv run --directory apps/api ruff format . && uv run --directory apps/api ruff check --fix .
scripts.typecheck: pnpm run typecheck:web && pnpm run typecheck:api
scripts.typecheck:api: uv run --directory apps/api mypy src tests
scripts.test: pnpm run test:web && pnpm run test:api
scripts.check: pnpm run lint && pnpm run typecheck && pnpm run test
